problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.
diagnosis: Cached old Wi-Fi credentials on the Windows laptop are preventing connection to the updated eduroam network. The phone works, confirming the issue is device-specific.
steps: Open Windows Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks.
Reconnect to eduroam and enter the new password when prompted.
Verify the university account is active via the university's account management portal.
